assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: a NEW full-screen background painting for the existing narrative game Aequilibrium, first chapter choice A, "accept the keys and care for the bookshop". Wide 16:9 horizontal frame, ideally 1672x941 or 1536x864. Not a UI, not a storyboard contact sheet.
Reference image1 (bookshop-night) is the SAME room's architecture/material/lighting continuity reference. Reference image2 (bookshop-day) is a supporting exact art-style reference. Preserve the old wood beams, plaster, floral porcelain table lamp, shelves of used books, right-side rain window looking onto the old coastal Chinese town. New camera angle and composition, no copied cut-and-paste.
PRIMARY SCENE: same autumn rainy night, intimate lower camera nearer the original worn wooden counter. The tabletop fills the LOWER LEFT half, its aged grain and rounded worn edge beautifully painted. An unfolded cream lease lies flat at around x38% y65%, with a small brass key deliberately laid alongside at x47% y63%. Paper has several faint blurred grey rules and a blank signature area, absolutely no readable text or numbers, no writing hand. The old floral porcelain lamp at left pools restrained amber light onto the document, with a plain closed cloth ledger farther back. Behind this, familiar low bookcases and right rain window softly recede. Cool slate blue rainy night outside; thin warm reflection on key. This should convey a decision becoming a real practical responsibility, quiet and grounded. The space to the right has natural floor/window negative space for later separately drawn actors, not a blank void.
STYLE: faithfully match the refs' realistic adult-world hand-painted cinematic film-storyboard illustration, precise but restrained gouache/oil brushwork, matte textured painted surfaces, slate grey / low-saturation moss / tobacco brown, subtle natural light. Same levels of detail and subdued contrast as original. No heightened fantasy glow, no 3D render, no photography, no anime, no harsh black outlines, no collage, no vignette frame.
No people, faces, hands, silhouettes, ghosts, speech bubbles, logos, watermark, UI, labels, charts or readable generated text. This is a standalone atmospheric narrative painting, not generic stock bookstore art.

At mid-left the same floral porcelain lamp makes a restrained warm pool that connects these places. No flowers/ornaments demanding attention. It is a cold early-winter evening; outside the right window the harbour blue-grey sky is fading, a bare twig and a little condensation along glass edges convey cold; old buildings and distant boat masts remain consistent. Warm low light in the table area, empty calm floor/wall to the right to leave room for later separate character layers. Room is EMPTY right now, no people or visible human shadows. A quiet inviting gathering, modest and everyday rather than grand celebration.
STYLE: exact refs' realistic hand-painted cinematic storyboard, painterly wood/paper/ceramic details, matte restrained oil/gouache brush texture, low-saturation slate/moss/tobacco, softly natural practical lamp light. PRIMARY SCENE: cold early-winter late evening at the familiar attic proofreading desk, seen from a thoughtful slightly angled frontal viewpoint across the near desk corner. A small worn brass adjustable task lamp near the left focuses its quiet amber light on two large open unmarked proof pages and a blue pencil laid diagonally across the nearer page. A squared-up substantial stack of unfinished manuscript sheets waits at the far-left of the light. A small pale chipped porcelain cup of cold dark tea sits untouched near the far edge, no steam. An empty old wooden chair beyond the desk, slightly to the left of the centre, faces the working seat that is out of frame. It is visibly a room suited to one person's work tonight, rather than people gathering. No envelope, no contract, no brass key, no symbols of despair.
Same dark roof slopes and wood beams, ragged neutral window curtain, shelves of old books, small window looking at the same coastal tiled roofs and distant boat masts. Outside is blue-grey cold night with fine condensation at the lower glass edge and a few rain tracks, soft bleak light rather than artificial cyan. Keep simple quiet plaster/floor space on the right for separate character layers. The concentration of light is the blue pencil and open proofs at x40% y65%; blank remaining page area enables exact dialogue to be overlaid later. All marks on papers/books are soft abstract grey strokes, no readable generated words, digits or symbols.
STYLE: exactly the refs' realistic restrained hand-painted film-storyboard aesthetic, matte gouache/oil texture with fine visible brushwork, tobacco wood, muted moss/slate shadows, practical natural light, adult-scale furniture, quiet everyday dignity. No cinematic neon, excessive bloom, fake depth-of-field blur, 3D render, cartoon/anime, HDR photo or fantasy imagery.
